prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Lagoon biome nature kit, 22 pieces, each drawn and labelled as its own piece, labels exactly as written in quotes, sizes as width x height. Row 1, TREES: "Salt-twisted tree, broad" 8 x 6 m (thick gnarled dark trunk bent hard sideways, buttress roots on dark stone, one wide flat-topped crown of dull olive clumps); "Salt-twisted tree, tall S-bend" 6 x 7 m (S-curved trunk, high main crown and a lower side pad); "Salt-twisted tree, low" 6.5 x 4.5 m (trunk sprawls along the ground then rises into one wide shallow crown); "Dead snag, tall" 5 x 6 m (bleached silver-grey dead trunk leaning, split base, bare forked branches, thick branches only); "Dead snag, broken" 3.5 x 4 m (short snapped bleached trunk leaning hard, jagged top). Row 2, PLANTS AND SHORE: "Reed bed" 2.5 x 2 m (tall olive and straw reeds with tawny seed heads); "Glowweed" 1.2 x 1 m (dark leafy clump with bulb-tipped fronds glowing soft teal); "Drift timber pile" 3.5 x 1 m (crossed grey weathered logs); "Shells and crab shells" 1.5 x 0.3 m (cream and pink shells and an empty rust-orange crab carapace); "Salt grass tuft, tall" 0.7 x 0.6 m; "Salt grass tuft, short" 0.4 x 0.35 m; "Wet moss patch" 1.2 x 0.2 m (flat damp olive moss cushion). Row 3, ROCK: "Basalt boulder, veined" 1.8 x 1.5 m (rounded dark basalt, moss crown, teal crystal veins); "Low column slab" 2 x 0.8 m (low run of hexagonal basalt column tops); "Column outcrop" 1.5 x 3 m (upright hexagonal columns of stepped heights); "Leaning boulder" 1.8 x 1.6 m (tilted angular dark slate boulder); "Slanted slate spire" 2 x 3.5 m (tall slanted dark slate slab with teal veins). Row 4, WATER AND ISLE EDGE: "Mere edge" 6 x 1.2 m (curved rim of dark basalt blocks stepping into still teal water with lily pads, reeds on the bank); "Lip ledge with trickle" 8 x 4 m (slick dark basalt ledges over the edge, salt grass on top, olive moss hanging, a thin chunky waterfall trickle from a notch, flat cut ends); "Lip ledge" 8 x 4 m (the same segment without the trickle and notch); "Underside spire, large" 8 x 12 m (inverted tapering spike of dark basalt column facets, spray streaks, weed strands from the rim, teal flecks); "Underside spire, small" 6 x 7 m (shorter, stubbier taper of the same rock). Dark basalt, olive greens and teal accents as in the attached sheet. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Lagoon nature kit".
